# Step 1: a USD invoice collected into a USD bank, which opens a cost basis on
# the bank at the rate the invoice was posted at.
#
# The shape a real book arrived in: 2,720.00 USD billed and received, against a
# CAD book. The collection is a payment block rather than a hand-written
# transaction, because that is the route that records what the money cost —
# `fx-balances` reports the basis afterwards, and its SPLIT GUID is what step 2
# spends against.
#
# Step 2 is `tests/fixtures/the_usd_bank_spent_out_against_its_basis.txt`.

2026-08-13 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-08-13 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-08-13 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-08-13 open Assets:Accounts Receivable USD
	type: Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-08-13 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-08-13 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-08-13 open Income:FX Gain
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-08-13 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-08-13 open Expenses:Bank charges
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-USD"
	name: "US Customer"
	currency: USD

invoice "INV-USD-1"
	customer_id: "C-USD"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-08-13
	entry:
		date: 2026-08-13
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 2720
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-08-13
		due: 2026-09-13
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-USD-1"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-08-13
		amount: 2720
		account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
		memo: "Payment for INV-USD-1"
